body.zh-Hant: 維多里諾·德拉普拉薩1840年11月2日生於阿根廷薩爾塔省。拉丁美洲史百科的條目稱他是布宜諾斯艾利斯大學培養的律師與金融家；總統府的胸像頁則說他在該校攻讀法律，1868年畢業。總統府畫廊頁記載他的妻子埃西爾達·B·卡斯特亞諾斯於1875年去世。
body.en: Victorino de la Plaza was born on 2 November 1840 in Salta Province, Argentina. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture calls him a lawyer trained at the University of Buenos Aires and a financier, and the presidential bust page says he studied law there and graduated in 1868. The presidential gallery page records that his wife, Ecilda B. Castellanos, died in 1875.

heading.en: In Roca's cabinet: foreign affairs and finance

body.zh-Hant: 在羅卡總統（1880至1886年）的內閣中，德拉普拉薩先於1882年2月11日至1883年10月25日任外交與宗教部長，再於1883年10月25日至1885年3月9日任財政部長。拉丁美洲史百科的條目另稱，他曾在三任總統下擔任內閣部長。
body.en: In President Roca's cabinet (1880 to 1886), de la Plaza served first as Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship from 11 February 1882 to 25 October 1883, and then as Minister of Finance from 25 October 1883 to 9 March 1885. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture adds that he served three presidents as a cabinet minister.

body.zh-Hant: 1908年6月22日，德拉普拉薩在何塞·菲格羅亞·阿爾科爾塔總統（1906至1910年）任內再度出任外交與宗教部長，任期到1910年8月9日；外交部歷史檔案館的歷任外長名單給出同樣的起訖日。
body.en: On 22 June 1908, under President Jose Figueroa Alcorta (1906 to 1910), de la Plaza again became Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship, serving until 9 August 1910; the Foreign Ministry's historical archive list of foreign ministers gives the same dates.

body.zh-Hant: 德拉普拉薩是羅克·薩恩斯·培尼亞（1910至1914年）的副總統；總統府的薩恩斯·培尼亞頁面列他為副總統，該任總統任期為1910年10月12日至1914年8月9日。拉丁美洲史百科說，他被選為副總統，是因為支持公平選舉程序、與政界關係良好，又不明確屬於任何派系；自1913年9月起，他因總統健康欠佳而代理總統，也有幾段較短的代理期。
body.en: De la Plaza was vice president to Roque Saenz Pena (1910 to 1914); the presidential page on Saenz Pena lists him as vice president of that term, which ran from 12 October 1910 to 9 August 1914. The encyclopedia says he was chosen for the vice presidency because of his support for fair voting procedures, his ties to the political establishment and his lack of clear identification with political factions, and that he was interim president from September 1913 and for several shorter periods owing to the president's ill health.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月9日薩恩斯·培尼亞去世，德拉普拉薩接任總統；總統府頁面把他的任期定為1914年8月9日至1916年10月12日。他任內面對第一次世界大戰，維持阿根廷中立，並試圖以讓阿根廷脫離金本位來應對日益嚴重的經濟危機；他雖然對改革後的選舉法與激進黨並不熱衷，仍監督了公平的選舉，結果激進黨獲勝。他於1919年10月2日在布宜諾斯艾利斯去世。
body.en: De la Plaza became president on 9 August 1914 on the death of Saenz Pena; the presidential page gives his term as 9 August 1914 to 12 October 1916. Facing the First World War, he kept Argentina neutral and attempted to meet a growing economic crisis by taking the country off the gold standard. Although not enthusiastic about the reformed electoral code or the Radical Party, he oversaw fair elections that produced a Radical victory. He died in Buenos Aires on 2 October 1919.

body.zh-Hant: 穆罕默德六世（瓦赫代丁）1861年1月4日生於多爾瑪巴赫切宮，父親是蘇丹阿卜杜勒邁吉德。他六個月大時喪父，四歲時喪母，由繼母沙耶斯泰哈農撫養；他自學並旁聽法提赫經學院的部分課程，住在兄長阿卜杜勒哈米德二世贈送的昌蓋爾柯伊別墅，直到成為蘇丹。1916年2月1日王儲優素福·伊澤丁自殺後，他被正式宣布為皇位繼承人；1916年與1917年，他曾代表蘇丹出席奧匈皇帝的葬禮與德皇的邀請。1918年7月3日穆罕默德·雷沙德去世，他以穆罕默德六世之名即位，但更常被稱為瓦赫代丁。
body.en: Mehmed VI (Vahdeddin) was born on 4 January 1861 in Dolmabahce Palace, the son of Sultan Abdulmecid. His father died when he was six months old and his mother when he was four, and he was raised by his stepmother Sayeste Hanim. He educated himself, attending some classes at the Fatih Medrese, and lived in the Cengelkoy villa given to him by his brother Abdulhamid II until he became sultan. After the suicide of the heir Yusuf Izzeddin (1 February 1916) he was formally declared heir to the Ottoman throne, and he represented the sultan at the Austro-Hungarian emperor's funeral (1916) and at the German emperor's invitation (1917). When Mehmed Resad died (3 July 1918) he took the throne as Mehmed VI, but was better known as Sultan Vahdeddin.

heading.en: Armistice and the dissolution of parliament

body.zh-Hant: 即位後，他在國民議會前宣誓，留任塔拉特帕夏政府。1918年10月7日，穆斯塔法·凱末爾帕夏發電報說，除了求和已無其他可做；10月14日蘇丹把組閣任務交給侍從武官艾哈邁德·伊澤特帕夏。蘇丹原想讓姻親達馬德·費里德帕夏率領停戰代表團，大宰相反對，結果由海軍大臣勞夫貝伊率團簽署《穆德羅斯停戰協定》（10月30日）。12月21日，他解散了議會。
body.en: After his accession he took the oath before the National Assembly and kept Talat Pasha's government in office. On 7 October 1918 Mustafa Kemal Pasha telegraphed that nothing remained to be done but make peace; on 14 October the sultan gave the task of forming a government to his aide Ahmed Izzet Pasha. The sultan wanted his relative Damad Ferid Pasha to head the armistice delegation, but the grand vizier objected, and the Turkish delegation under the Navy Minister Rauf Bey signed the Armistice of Mudros (30 October). On 21 December he dissolved parliament.

heading.zh-Hant: 大宰相更迭與伊斯坦堡被占領
heading.en: Grand viziers and the occupation of Istanbul

body.zh-Hant: 1919年3月4日，塔夫菲克帕夏辭職，達馬德·費里德帕夏出任大宰相。1920年3月16日，伊斯坦堡被正式占領，所有官方機構遭接管；同年4月23日，大國民議會在安卡拉集會，宣稱自己是國家唯一的代表。1920年10月21日，蘇丹任命塔夫菲克帕夏為大宰相。
body.en: On 4 March 1919 Tevfik Pasha resigned and Damad Ferid Pasha was brought to the grand vizierate. On 16 March 1920 Istanbul was officially occupied and all official institutions were taken over, and on 23 April 1920 the Grand National Assembly met in Ankara and declared itself the nation's only representative. On 21 October 1920 the sultan brought Tevfik Pasha to the grand vizierate.

heading.zh-Hant: 廢除蘇丹制、流亡與去世

body.zh-Hant: 1922年11月1日，議會廢除了蘇丹制。依決定，蘇丹於11月17日早晨乘「馬拉亞號」被送離伊斯坦堡，船隨後駛往馬爾他。他於1923年1月15日抵達吉達，1923年5月2日在熱那亞港受到非正式儀式迎接，隨後住進聖雷莫的諾貝爾別墅。1926年5月16日，他在得知哈里發大會召開的消息前去世；遺體於1926年7月3日在大馬士革安葬。
body.en: On 1 November 1922 the assembly abolished the sultanate. It was decided that on the morning of 17 November the sultan would be taken out of Istanbul on the ship Malaya, which then sailed for Malta. He reached Jeddah on 15 January 1923, was received at the port of Genoa in an informal ceremony on 2 May 1923, and settled at the Villa Nobel in San Remo. He died on 16 May 1926, before hearing that the caliphate congress had convened; his body was buried in Damascus on 3 July 1926.

heading.en: Origins, studies and the early resistance

body.zh-Hant: 愛德華·貝奈斯1884年5月28日生於科日拉尼，是農民兼小商人的么子。他在布拉格捷克大學讀現代語文，後來又在第戎、巴黎和柏林研讀政治學與法律，1909年取得哲學博士。1909年起到1915年，他在布拉格商業學院教外語，並在政治上活躍於進步（現實派）黨。一次大戰爆發後，他加入反奧地利的抵抗運動，是「現實派」抵抗團體的創始人之一，1915年春成為捷克「馬菲亞」的組織者之一，同年9月初流亡國外。
body.en: Edvard Benes was born on 28 May 1884 in Kozlany, the youngest son of a farmer and small trader. He studied modern philology at the Czech university in Prague and later political science and law at Dijon, Paris and Berlin (PhDr. 1909). From 1909 until 1915 he taught languages at the Prague commercial academy, and in politics he was active in the Progressive (Realist) party. After the First World War broke out he joined the anti-Austrian resistance, was among the founders of the Realist resistance group and in spring 1915 became one of the organisers of the Czech Maffia; in early September 1915 he went into exile.

citations.quote: BENEŠ Edvard (28. 5. 1884, Kožlany – 3. 9. 1948, Sezimovo Ústí)

heading.en: Exile in Paris and the provisional government

body.zh-Hant: 從1915年秋到大戰結束，貝奈斯主要在巴黎活動，參與成立捷克外國委員會；1916年2月他被任命為捷克國民委員會（後稱捷克斯洛伐克國民委員會）秘書。他促成在法國建立獨立的捷克斯洛伐克軍隊（1917年12月16日協議），也推動協約國把建立獨立國家納入戰爭目標。1918年10月中旬，國民委員會改組為以馬薩里克為首的第一屆臨時政府，他出任外交部長，並一度兼任內政部長。
body.en: From autumn 1915 until the end of the war Benes was based mainly in Paris and helped found the Czech Foreign Committee; in February 1916 he was appointed secretary of the Czech National Council (later the Czechoslovak National Council). He contributed to the permission to build an independent Czechoslovak army in France (agreement of 16 December 1917) and to getting an independent state into the Entente's war aims. In mid-October 1918 the National Council was turned into the first provisional government under Masaryk, and he became foreign minister and, for a time, interior minister.

podílel se na založení Českého komitétu zahraničního

body.zh-Hant: 此後貝奈斯又主持外交部門十七年。他與總理克拉馬爾一起率領捷克斯洛伐克代表團出席巴黎和會，並參與確立新共和國在中歐的國際地位，其主軸是與南斯拉夫、羅馬尼亞的「小協約」；1924年1月與法國簽訂同盟條約。他在國際聯盟理事會任職（1923至1927年及1931至1932年），參與起草1924年的《日內瓦議定書》，1935年秋擔任國聯大會主席。1921至1922年他任總理，並在1919至1926年及1929至1935年擔任國民議會議員。
body.en: Benes stayed at the head of the foreign-policy department for a further seventeen years. With prime minister Kramar he led the Czechoslovak delegation at the Paris Peace Conference and took part in anchoring the young republic in Central Europe, centred on the Little Entente alliance with Yugoslavia and Romania; in January 1924 he signed an alliance treaty with France. He sat on the League of Nations Council (1923 to 1927 and 1931 to 1932), co-authored the 1924 Geneva Protocol and in autumn 1935 chaired the League Assembly. In 1921 to 1922 he was also prime minister, and he was a member of the National Assembly in 1919 to 1926 and 1929 to 1935.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二任總統與慕尼黑危機
heading.en: Second president and the Munich crisis

body.zh-Hant: 1935年12月18日，馬薩里克辭職後，貝奈斯在布拉格城堡的弗拉迪斯拉夫廳被選為總統，獲340票，對手博胡米爾·涅梅茨獲24票。他當選後仍保有對外交政策的決定性影響，由外長克羅夫塔依其意旨執行。1938年9月29至30日慕尼黑會議後，他被迫於10月5日辭職並離開國家。
body.en: On 18 December 1935, after Masaryk's abdication, Benes was elected president in the Vladislav Hall of Prague Castle, with 340 votes against 24 for his opponent Bohumil Nemec. After his election he kept a decisive influence over foreign policy, which foreign minister Krofta conducted in line with his wishes. After the Munich conference of 29 to 30 September 1938 he was forced to abdicate on 5 October and leave the country.

heading.en: Exile and leadership of the resistance

body.zh-Hant: 1939年初他在芝加哥大學任教。1940年7月，在他倡議下於英國成立流亡的臨時國家機構，他在其中擔任總統，這個機構後來獲所有反希特勒同盟國家承認。他視蘇聯為戰後捷克斯洛伐克的關鍵盟友，1943年12月12日的條約印證了這一點。
body.en: From early 1939 he taught at the University of Chicago. In July 1940, on his initiative, a provisional state structure in exile was created in Britain, in which he took the office of president; it was later recognised by all states of the anti-Hitler coalition. He saw the USSR as the key ally of the future Czechoslovakia, as the treaty of 12 December 1943 confirmed.
